owner: M2 Stage 2K.1R2 percentile observation-set lineage closeout
purpose: Bind every valuation percentile to a full observation-set identity: the set of market observations from which the percentile was computed, the set digest, the PIT exclusion policy, and the effective sample counts.

pit_exclusion_policy.rule: observations with trade_date > market_data_as_of_date are excluded from the percentile sample

percentile_definition.status: computed only when latest value is computable and >= minimum observations
percentile_definition.percentile_3y: rank of latest value within the trailing 3y window (trade_date >= 2023-07-31)
percentile_definition.percentile_5y: rank of latest value within the trailing 5y window (trade_date >= 2021-07-31)

observation_set_digest_rule.hash: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, no whitespace)

prohibited_fallbacks: do not report a percentile without its observation-set digest
do not include observations after market_data_as_of_date in the percentile sample
do not treat a coverage gap (non-computed percentile) as a zero

identity_inclusion.note: observation-set identity (digest, provider, scope, sample counts) must be embedded in the capsule observation_set and in the score_input_id canonical payload
